entities.name: Miloš Teodosić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miloš Teodosić is a Serbian former professional basketball player. He also represented the National Basketball Team of Serbia internationally. He primarily played the point guard and shooting guard positions. He is a six time All-EuroLeague selection, and was voted EuroLeague MVP in 2010.
